lines: Hello, there! I've seen you, but I never had a chance to talk!
reward: Here's a gift for dropping by!
TM41 teaches Softboiled! Only one Pokémon can use it! That Pokémon is Chansey!

lines: Welcome to the Rocket Game Corner!
shop: Do you need some game coins?

lines: I'm guarding this poster!
battle: Our hideout might be discovered! I better tell boss!

lines: Who are you?
battle: You're not going to get away with this, brat!
We got word from upstairs that you were coming!
Silph Scope? The machine the boss stole. It's here somewhere.

lines: I know you!
battle: You ruined our plans at Pewter!
Do you have something against Team Rocket?

lines: So! I must say...
battle: I am impressed you got here!
I see that you raise Pokémon with utmost care. A child like you would never understand what I hope to achieve. I shall step aside this time! I hope we meet again...

lines: Hello. Lovely weather isn't it? It's so pleasant.
...Oh dear... I must have dozed off. Welcome. My name is Erika. I am the Leader of Celadon Gym.
I teach the art of flower arranging. My Pokémon are of the grass-type.
battle: Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that you wished to challenge me. Very well, but I shall not lose.
Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong. I must confer you the Rainbow Badge.
You are cataloging Pokémon? I must say I'm impressed. I would never collect Pokémon if they were unattractive.
reward: Please also take this with you.
TM19 contains Giga Drain. Half the damage it inflicts is drained to heal your Pokémon. Wouldn't you agree that it's a wonderful move?

lines: Hello! Welcome to Celadon Department Store!
Please enjoy your visit and find whatever you need.
Oh, hi! I finally finished Pokemon!
reward: Not done yet? This might be useful!
TM18 is Counter! Not like the one I'm leaning on, mind you!

lines: Captured Pokemon are registered with the name of the Original Trainer that caught it!
All right! My buddy's going to trade me his Kangaskhan for my Graveler!
Come on Graveler! I love Graveler! I collect them!
Huh?
Graveler turned into a different Pokémon!
I'm getting an Ice Stone for my girlfriend!
I heard something useful.
Some Pokémon need evolution stones to evolve!
Pokémon ability enhancers can be bought only here.
Use Calcium to increase special abilities.
Use Carbos to increase speed.
I'm here for Pokémon ability enhancers.
Protein increases attack power.
Iron increases defense!
